item.title: Harvard hires graduate charged with assaulting Israeli classmate
item.description: Harvard University recently hired a graduate of its Divinity School who was criminally charged with assaulting an Israeli classmate during an anti-Israel protest. Elom Tettey-Tamaklo is now working as a teaching fellow at the school, earning a stipend of up to $11,000, according to The Washington Free Beacon. item.title: Bates College delays ‘Race, Power, Privilege, Colonialism’ requirement – because Trump
item.description: Bates College faculty have postponed the "Race, Power, Privilege, and Colonialism" requirement for three years to protect the community from potential federal scrutiny under the Trump administration. The delay emphasizes "care" for marginalized faculty and students while highlighting concerns over academic freedom and the challenges of implementing such curriculum amidst political pressures.

item.title: U. Oklahoma professor on leave after offering excuse for protest supporting trans TA
item.description: The University of Oklahoma placed assistant professor Kelli Alvarez on leave for offering to excuse students to protest in support of a transgender TA, while not accommodating opposing views.

item.title: New FAFSA update flags colleges with ‘lower earnings’ for graduates
item.description: As part of the Free Application for Federal Student Aid process, the U.S. Department of Education will warn first-year undergraduate students if a school has low graduate earnings beginning this week. item.title: Christian student who received 0% from her trans TA speaks out
item.description: The College Fix's Hannah Brady talks to University of Oklahoma junior Samantha Fulnecky about getting flunked by a trans teaching assistant who disagreed with her Christian views.

item.title: Johns Hopkins grad student battles union that wants her fired
item.description: A Fulbright Scholar takes on her next challenge - a powerful graduate student.

item.description: A national faculty coalition is pushing to grant non-citizens First Amendment protections, demanding that the Trump administration be permanently barred from revoking visas over pro-Palestinian activism or support for terrorist groups. item.title: Augsburg U. criticizes ‘disturbing’ ICE arrest of ‘registered sex offender’ student
item.description: Minnesota university calls ICE arrest of student 'profoundly disturbing' - except he is a sex offender.

item.title: U. Maryland opens ‘Black & Indigenous’ art gallery to address ‘climate anxiety’
item.description: The University of Maryland's new art gallery is dedicated to 'Black and Indigenous' environmental art. However, outside scholars criticize it for promoting only one perspective about climate change.

item.title: 14 elite colleges given F grades in antisemitism ‘report card’
item.description: 'The 2025 findings prove that antisemitism on campus is systemic, not episodic,' report states.
